    Reliability and environmental

    MTBF                                                              2 000 000 hours

1
 Based on tests performed in Crystal Disk Mark 5.2.1 on SSD in FOB (fresh-out-of-box) state. Actual results may vary depending on your system configuration or SSD wear.
2
 Storage capacity for GOODRAM SSD is provided in decimal values, i.e. 1GB = 1 000 000 000 bytes
3
 After exceeding the TBW or 3 years, the SSD is not covered by warranty.
